Status of expelled Members
*201. SHRI PYARIMOHAN
MOHAPATRA: Will the Minister of LAW
AND JUSTICE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that certain
eventualities such as expulsion of Members
from political parties have not been
provided for in the Tenth Schedule of the
Constitution; and
(b) if so, whether Government are
contemplating to bring in any amendment
in this regard?
Cultural complex in Tamil Nadu
*202. SHRI S.P.M. SYED KHAN: Will
the Minister of CULTURE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
have not chosen Tamil Nadu for setting up
of Multi-purpose cultural complex as the
Tamil region has been one of the very old
settlements in the world having thousands
of temples;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor;
(c) the details of the multi-purpose
cultural complexes sanctioned so far in the
country; and
(d) the details of the multi-purpose
cultural complexes proposed by
Government?
Wakf Board's claim on heritage
monuments
†*203. SHRI MUKHTAR ABBAS
NAQVI: Will the Minister of SOCIAL
JUSTICE AND EMPOWERMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) whether certain Wakf Boards have
claimed their rights on certain heritage sites,
monuments and places, on the pretext of
existence of religious symbols like mosque,
graves and prayer leading to an atmosphere
of widespread reaction and concern in the
country;
(b) if so, the steps and legal remedies
Government propose against such baseless,
irresponsible and unconstitutional claims;
and
(c) the justification for existence of
religious Wakf Boards in a democratic
secular country and the alternative

arrangement proposed by Government for
maintenance of the religious places and wakf

religious Wakf Boards?
Recognition as backward classes
†*204. SHRI NAND KISHORE
YADAV: Will the Minister of SOCIAL
JUSTICE AND EMPOWERMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the National Commission
for Backward Classes examines all the
applications for granting recognition as
backward classes; and
(b) if so, the number of applications
received so far and those pending with the
Commission at present, State-wise?
FM radio policy phase II
*205. SHRI N.K. PREMA-
CHANDRAN: Will the Minister of
INFORMATION AND BROAD-
CASTING be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government implemented
the policy of phase II of FM radio;
(b) if so, the number of the cities brought
under the new phase;
(c) the number of the frequencies of
1st phase which have been activated and
the reasons, if any, for the unsustainability
thereof; and
(d) whether Government have
permitted the private radios to broadcast
news and other current affairs programmes?
States share in Sarva Shiksha
Abhiyan
†*206. SHRI MOTILAL VORA:
SHRI JANARDAN DWIVEDI:
Will the Minister of HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the State
Governments are not contributing their
share of 25 per cent for the Sarva Shiksha
Abhiyan sponsored by Government;
(b) if so, the States which had not given
their contribution for the programme during
the last three years; and
(c) the contribution from all the States
during the last five years under this
programme, year-wise?
Irregularities in Mid-Day Meal
Scheme
*207. DR. NARAYAN SINGH
MANAKLAO: Will the Minister of
HUMAN RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that several
irregularities such as pilferage, manipulation
of the record of delivery and utilisation of
ration and funds etc., have been brought
out by media recently in the current state
of Mid-Day Meal Scheme in Government
run primary schools;
(b) if so, the details of the irregularities
detected and the remedial measures taken/
proposed to be taken in this regard;
(c) whether it is also a fact that in most
of the schools, the teachers, instead of
teaching, are cooking the mid-day meal; and
(d) if so, the remedial steps taken in
this regard?

64
Non-utilization of funds for Higher
Education
*208. SHRIMATI AMBIKA SONI:
SHRI HARISH RAWAT:
Will the Minister of HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the schemes
for higher education are suffering due to
non-utilization of the available resources;
(b) the funds allocated to the State
Government/NGOs during the last three
years indicating the details of the funds
lying unspent with them; and
(c) the measures taken by Government
to ensure cent per cent utilisation of the
funds?
Schools for children in Handloom
industry
*209. SHRIMATI MOHSINA
KIDWAI: Will the Minister of HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware that
children working in the Handloom industry
and most of the children living in slums
doing odd jobs in small shops do not have
access to schools;
(b) if so, whether Government have
prepared any plan to educate such children
and whether Government would implement
the scheme of door step schools, or schools
on wheels; and
(c) if so, the details thereof and if not,
the reasons therefor?
Directions issued to PSUs
*210. SHRI S.S. AHLUWALIA: Will
the Minister of HEAVY INDUSTRIES
AND PUBLIC ENTERPRISES be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
have issued directions from time to time to
the managements of the enterprises in
public sector (PSUs);
(b) the number of the directions issued
indicating those generally applicable to all
PSUs and those specific ones for particular
PSUs, PSU-wise, consolidated year-wise
since 1998-99 till the 30th June, 2005;
(c) whether any review of such
directions has been carried out from time
to time especially with a view to distinguish
those directions which tend to impinge
autonomy of the management with other;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) if not, the reasons therefor?
Setting up of Minority Commission/
Advisory Committees
†*211. SHRIMATI KUM KUM RAI:
Will the Minister of SOCIAL JUSTICE
AND EMPOWERMENT  be pleased to
state:
(a) the number of the States in which
the Minority Commission/Advisory
Committee has been constituted by the
National Minority Commission;
(b) the number of the States in which
such commission/committee has not been
constituted so far; and
(c) the reasons therefor?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

65
Literacy rate
*212. SHRI S. ANBALAGAN: Will the
Minister of HUMAN RESOURCE
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) the current literacy rate of the
country and that of the States, State-wise;
(b) whether the country is still lagging
behind many developing countries in terms
of literacy rate;
(c) if so, the steps taken by Government
during the last two years and those
proposed to be taken to increase the
literacy rate;
(d) whether it is a fact that female
literacy rate is less than the male literacy
rate; and
(e) if so, the details thereof, State-wise,
and the steps being taken/proposed to be
taken in this regard?
Limit on election expenditure
†*213. SHRIMATI PREMA
CARIAPPA:
SHRI MOTILAL VORA:
Will the Minister of LAW AND
JUSTICE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Election
Commission has given any suggestion to
Government for fixing a limit of expenditure
by the political parties on elections also, as
was done for the individual candidate;
(b) whether Government have also
received other suggestions from the Election
Commission; and
(c) if so, the details thereof and
Government's reaction thereto?
Affairs of CPWD
*214. SHRIMATI BIMBA RAIKAR:
Will the Minister of URBAN
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether despite having a 7000 strong
technical workforce for competitive
construction and designing work, the
CPWD has engaged a private consultant to
modernize the department;
(b) whether CPWD works are mostly
allotted to the private contractors rendering
the regular workforce idle and unproductive;
(c) whether CPWD is technically
competent to provide consultancy and
turn-key jobs to DDA, HUDCO etc.; and
(d) if so, whether CPWD has provided
any such service so far?
Penalty for Sonia Vihar Plant
*215. SHRI R.K. ANAND: Will the
Minister of URBAN DEVELOPMENT
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
would have to pay Rs. 2.3 lakhs per day as
penalty to the multi-national company
Degremont if Sonia Vihar Plant is not made
operational;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) what steps have been initiated to
provide water to the residents of Delhi?
Vacancies in Supreme Court
*216. SHRIMATI JAYA BACH-
CHAN: Will the Minister of LAW AND
JUSTICE be pleased to state:
(a) the number of Supreme Court Judges
who have either retired or are due to retire
this year;
(b) whether Government have
completed its exercise to fill up the resultant
vacancies expeditiously;
(c) if not, the reasons therefor; and
(d) by when the appointments are likely
to be finalized?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

Ali Yavar Jung National Institute for
Hearing Handicapped
*217. SHRI S.M. LALJAN BASHA:
Will the Minister of SOCIAL JUSTICE
AND EMPOWERMENT be pleased to
state:
(a) the academic courses offered at the
Ali Yavar Jung National Institute for
Hearing Handicapped in Mumbai;
(b) whether any review has been done
keeping in view the need to expand the
number of courses offered by the institute;
(c) if so, the details thereof;
(d) whether its branches would be set
up in different places; and
(e) if so, the details thereof?
Kasturba Gandhi Balika Vidyalayas
*218. SHRI MOTIUR RAHMAN:
MAULANA OBAIDULLAH
KHAN AZMI:
Will the Minister of HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to refer to the answer to Unstarred
Question 17 given in the Rajya Sabha on
the 25th July, 2005 and state:
(a) the details of the Kasturba Gandhi
Balika Vidyalayas in Delhi where English
medium is not available in Arts stream at
10+2 level;
(b) the reasons therefor and the steps
being taken in the matter;
(c) the details of such schools where
Science and Commerce streams are not
available;
(d) the reasons therefor and the action
being taken in the matter; and
(e) by when, the above facilities would
be provided?
Deemed University Status
*219. SHRI R. KAMARAJ: Will the
Minister of HUMAN RESOURCE
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Indian
Law Institute has been conferred Deemed
University status;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the other institutes to which
Government had conferred Deemed
University status recently;
(d) whether it is also a fact that many
applications seeking deemed university
status had been rejected by Government;
and
(e) if so, the details thereof?
Committee for reconstitution of
Prasar Bharati
†*220. SHRI JANARDAN
DWIVEDI:
SHRI MOTILAL VORA:
Will the Minister of INFORMATION
AND BROADCASTING be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that a committee

of Prasar Bharati is affecting the functioning
of Doordarshan and Akashwani also; and
(d) if so, the steps being taken by
Government for speedy reconstitution of

Development of arts and culture
1419. SHRI N. R. GOVINDARAJAR:
Will the Minister of CULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) the achievements made by
Government towards promotion and
development of arts and culture;
(b) the achievements made and the
activities undertaken by Government
through cultural centres both in the country
and abroad during each of the last three
years;
(c) whether Government have set up
Cultural Resources and Training Centres
for foreigners; and
(d) if so, the details of the functions
and objectives thereof and achievements
made by them?
Heritage sites and monuments
†1420. SHRI MUKHTAR ABBAS
NAQVI: Will the Minister of CULTURE
be pleased to state:
(a) the detailed list of the heritage sites
and monuments under Government's
control;
(b) the measures taken for their
maintenance and security; and
(c) the action taken by Government on
destruction of a number of heritage sites,
monuments and statues in Rampur district
of Uttar Pradesh?
Heritage monuments in Karnataka
1421. DR. VIJAY MALLYA: Will the
Minister of CULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) the number of heritage monuments
identified in Karnataka;
(b) the number of those managed by the
Archaeological Survey of India;
(c) whether it is a fact that the State has
no comprehensive heritage legislation to
regulate unauthorized encroachments and
urbanizations in such areas; and
(d) whether any proposal is under
Government's consideration to introduce
any legislation to regulate and preserve such
monuments of historical importance?

322
Tricentenary anniversary of Gur-Ta-
Gaddi
1422. SHRI R. S. GAVAI: Will the
Minister of CULTURE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the State
Government of Maharashtra has requested
for grant-in-aid from the Prime Minister
Fund/Central Government for Tricentenary
Anniversary of Gur-Ta-Gaddi at Nanded
city;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) Government's response thereto?
Culture of Tamil Nadu
1423. SHRI S. ANBALAGAN: Will
the Minister of CULTURE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government have made any
initiatives to safeguard and promote culture
of Tamil Nadu;
(b) if so, the details thereof and the
achievements made in this regard
including the amount allocated for the
purpose; and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?
Remnants of an ancient civilisation in
Amreli
1424. SHRI EKANATH K. THAKUR:
Will the Minister of CULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that remnants
of an ancient civilisation have emerged
in Amreli district as the waters of
Shetrunji river receded after the recent
floods; and
(b) if so, the details thereof?
Sirpur Archaeological Complex
1425. SHRI EKANATH K. THAKUR:
Will the Minister of CULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that a 1500 year
old city, complete with a palace, temples,
houses and Buddhist educational centre big
enough to accommodate 10,000 students
has been discovered at Sirpur, in
Chhattisgarh;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) whether it is a fact that the Sirpur
Archaeological Complex is almost four
times as big as Nalanda?
Setting up of science city
1426. SHRI T.T.V. DHINAKARAN:
Will the Minister of CULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) the details of science cities set up/
proposed to be set up in the country
together with its aim and scope;
(b) whether all the States would be
covered under this scheme so as to have
cross-cultural interactions through these
science cities; and
(c) the funds allocated for this purpose
during the current year?
Implementation of project schemes
for NER
1427. SHRI NABAM REBIA: Will the
Minister of DEVELOPMENT OF
NORTH EASTERN REGION be pleased
to state:
(a) the details of the major scheme being
undertaken/proposed to be undertaken by
the North Eastern Council (NEC) in NER
during the Tenth Five Year Plan period
sector-wise;

323
(b) whether the NEC has deviced a fool
proof mechanism to evaluate, monitor and
ascertain progress of the implementation
of such schemes in the region; and
(c) the role of the State Governments in
finalisation and implementation of such
projects?
Revival of Braithwaite and Company
Ltd.
1428. SHRI DIPANKAR MUKHER-
JEE:
SHRI CHITTABRATA
MAJUMDAR:
Will the Minister of HEAVY
INDUSTRIES AND PUBLIC
ENTERPRISES be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Board for
Reconstruction of Public Sector Enterprises
has approved revival plan of the
Braithwaite and Company Ltd.;
(b) if not, the reasons therefor; and
(c) if so, the time bound programme for
implementing the revival plan?
Closure of units of Burn Standard
Company Ltd.
1429. SHRI CHITTABRATA
 MAJUMDAR:
SHRI DIPANKAR
MUKHERJEE:
Will the Minister of HEAVY
INDUSTRIES AND PUBLIC
ENTERPRISES be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Board of the Burn
Standard Company Ltd. had recommended
closure of units of Burnpur and Howrah in
West Bengal;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) Government's reaction thereto and
their plan to tide over the working capital
crunch and other problems faced by the
company to facilitate their early revival?
Autonomy to PSUs
1430. SHRI B. K. HARIPRASAD: Will
the Minister of HEAVY INDUSTRIES
AND PUBLIC ENTERPRISES be pleased
to state:
(a) whether the Arjun Sengupta Panel
has recommended for giving more
autonomy for PSUs;
(b) whether the panel has suggested that
PSUs should not be subject to Public
Interest Litigations and Parliament
questions and that a statutory audit is
sufficient for PSUs and their books need
not be audited by CAG;
(c) whether necessary amendments
under Article 12 of the Constitution have
been finalized; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Status of HEC and MECON Ltd.
1431. SHRI S. S. AHLUWALIA: Will
the Minister of HEAVY INDUSTRIES
AND PUBLIC ENTERPRISES be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Heavy
Engineering Corporation (HEC) and
MECON Ltd., Ranchi, are contemplated
to be closed down by Government;
(b) if so, the rationale therefor;
(c) if not, the measures for their revival,
if any, under implementation, unit-wise;
(d) the number of employees made to
leave these undertakings under the forced
retirement schemes, year-wise and
category-wise and their present strength;

324
(e) the outstanding debts to be recovered
by the two undertakings from their
customers alongwith the details of these
debtors as on the 30th June of 2003, 2004
and 2005; and
(f) the volume of their outstanding loans
to banks/FIs as on the above dates?
Revival of PSUs
1432. SHRI V. NARAYANASAMY:
Will the Minister of HEAVY INDUSTRIES
AND PUBLIC ENTERPRISES be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that there is a
sharp disagreement between his Ministry
and the Board for Reconstruction of Public
Sector Enterprises over the revival of ailing
Public Sector Undertakings; and
(b) if so, the number of PSUs referred
to BRPSE?
Payment of salaries of
PSUs
1433. SHRI MURLI DEORA: Will the
Minister of HEAVY INDUSTRIES AND
PUBLIC ENTERPRISES be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government have been
paying the salaries of some of the PSUs, if
so, their names alongwith the amount paid
to each of them;
(b) the name of the PSUs which have
got revival packages during the last two
years and the amount given with results
achieved; and
(c) the steps taken to strengthen their
performance?
Extension of Purchase Preference
Policy for PSUs
1434. SHRIMATI N. P. DURGA: Will
the Minister of HEAVY INDUSTRIES
AND PUBLIC ENTERPRISES be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Group of
Ministers has recommended for extension
of Purchase Preference Policy for PSUs by
three more years;
(b) whether it is also a fact that the
Ministry of Power is opposing the
extension of Purchase Preference Policy;
(c) whether any threshold limit has been
fixed on the value of tenders; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
CABE Committee Recommendations
1435. SHRI B. J. PANDA:
SHRI RAVI SHANKAR
PRASAD:
Will the Minister of HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Central
Advisory Board of Education (CABE)
Committee has suggested uniform physical
and human infrastructure and provision of
25 per cent seats in private schools for the
poor children, in primary education;
(b) if so, the details of the
recommendations of the committee; and
(c) the status of implementation of these
recommendations?
Reservation on religious basis
1436. SHRI S. S. AHLUWALIA: Will
the Minister of HUMAN RESOURCE
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have been

325
ordering reservation of seats on religious
basis in Central Universities in their
graduation and post-graduation levels'
courses;
(b) the details of such universities
alongwith the respective orders issued
during the last ten years;
(c) the principles governing issuance of
orders for reservations on such basis;
(d) the average proportion of students
belonging to various religions, including the
reserved ones, secured admission in the
respective universities pursuant to such
order during the above period, stream-wise

(e) the details of the provisions of
reservations of seats, if any, under other
categories in vogue in those Central
Universities alongwith the years of their
introduction?
Opening of Kendriya Vidyalayas
1437. SHRI DATTA MEGHE: Will the
Minister of HUMAN RESOURCE
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether there is a proposal under
Government's consideration to open more
Kendriya Vidyalayas in the current
academic year;
(b) if so, the details thereof and the
proposed locations of the new Kendriya
Vidyalayas;
(c) whether at present more than 200
Kendriya Vidyalayas are functioning in the
temporary/hired buildings;
(d) if so, since when and the locations
thereof; and
(e) the progress made so far in
construction of the permanent buildings for
these Kendriya Vidyalayas and for
providing infrastructural facilities there?
Financial assistance for computer
education
1438. SHRI JANARDHANA
POOJARY: Will the Minister of HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government extend
financial assistance to the States for
spreading computer education in
schools;
(b) if so, the details thereof with the
financial assistance released during the last
five years, year-wise and State-wise;
(c) whether on account of inordinate
delay in releasing the funds under the
scheme to the States, the computer
education in schools is interrupted;
(d) if so, the details of the outstanding
amount under the scheme, State-wise; and
(e) the steps taken for regular disbursal
of the funds to facilitate uninterrupted
progress of computer education in schools
in all the States, with special reference to
Karnataka?
Children out of School
1439. SHRI R. K. ANAND: Will the
Minister of HUMAN RESOURCE
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the country
has a whopping 26.8 million primary
school age children out of the schools;
(b) whether it is also a fact that the
country accounts for 23 per cent of the
total global school children; and
(c) if so, the details thereof and by when
these children would be given basic
education?

326

MURTHY: Will the Minister of HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the Karnataka Government
has requested Government to teach
Kannada as one subject in all the Kendriya
Vidyalayas located in the State; and
(b) if so, the action taken thereon?
Expenditure on Navodaya Vidyalayas
1441. SHRI T. T. V. DHINAKARAN:
Will the Minister of HUMAN RESOURCE
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) the expenditure incurred on
Navodaya Vidyalayas during the past three
years; year-wise;
(b) the States where Navodaya
Vidyalayas have not been set up so far; and
(c) whether Government would
reconsider the language policy in respect
of the Navodaya Vidyalayas to
accommodate the views of non Hindi
speaking States?
Practice of sati

Will the Minister of HUMAN RESOURCE
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware of
the fact that it has been eighteen years since
the Commission of Sati (Prevention) Act
was passed, but Sati is still a way of life in
Rajasthan; and
(b) if so, the steps the Government
propose to take to stop this heinous
practice?
Irregularities in entrance
tests

SHRI AMAR SINGH:
Will the Minister of HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that there have
been a lot of irregularities in the recent
entrance test conducted by the Delhi
College of Engin eering and Netaji
Subhash Institute of Technology wherein
more than 1000 students figure in the
merit list;
(b) if so, the details thereof and the action
taken against the guilty person; and
(c) whether the result of test has not
been cancelled and if so, the reasons
therefor?
Admission under Special dispensation
Powers
1444. SHRI AMAR SINGH:
SHRI ABU ASIM AZMI:
Will the Minister of HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) the number of requests received from
each MP's during the current year for
admission in the Kendriya Vidyalayas
under the Special Dispensation Powers over
and above the quota of two admissions
earmarked for each MP;
(b) the number of such requests from
